local_review.finding_body: The coordinate build script hardcoded version 5.1.11 for micronaut-http-client and micronaut-inject-java instead of using the TCK-selected library version. This violated the version-agnostic test requirement in §FS-test-contract.2.5 because a copied suite would continue resolving those dependencies at 5.1.11.
local_review.finding_title: Test dependencies pin the requested artifact version
local_review.fix_note: Changed both Micronaut support dependencies in the coordinate's build.gradle to use $libraryVersion, keeping the full Micronaut test dependency set aligned with the tested version. The exact Forge-owned finalization command then completed successfully with a stable publishable tree.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test behavior, metadata file scope, index and resolved statistics. The tests exercise public HTTP client APIs in a separate package without scaffold code, native-image skips, legacy metadata, direct dynamic-access shortcuts, or unsupported build flags. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case, so percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. After the repair, Forge finalization passed all three native test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
